editorial:
Imagine you are trapped on Alcatraz Island while the rest of San Francisco turns into a zombie wasteland. That is the wild setup you get here. You follow a group of survivors who think they are safe behind prison walls, but as you can guess, the undead eventually find a way in. The vibe is a mix of high stakes and classic survival horror, making you feel the panic as the group realizes their safe haven is actually a trap. It is a fun ride that does not take itself too seriously, focusing more on the thrill of the chase than deep drama.

What really works is the pacing, as the action keeps moving quickly so you never get bored. The acting is decent for a B-movie, and the fight scenes are plenty of fun. While some of the special effects look a bit cheap, it actually adds to the charm. If you love mindless zombie action, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you want the best picture, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see those zombies in detail.
endingExplained: After fighting their way through the city, the survivors make a final push to escape the mainland. They face a massive horde of zombies in a series of intense battles. In the end, the remaining group manages to find a way out, though not everyone makes it. It wraps up with a feeling of hope, showing that while the world has fallen, the strong survivors can still find a way to keep going.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves zombie apocalypse stories and fast action.
